# AISquared


> AISquared is the infrastructure layer for agentic enterprise AI. It lets organizations build, deploy, and govern AI applications inside the systems their teams already use — connecting trusted data, governed workflows, embedded delivery, security, and continuous feedback in one platform. Built on the AI Controls Framework, AISquared helps enterprises, federal agencies, and growth teams move AI from pilots to production without tool sprawl or migration.


## About


- [About Us](https://aisquared.ai/about/): Company mission, team, and approach to operationalizing enterprise AI.
- [Careers](https://aisquared.ai/careers/): Open roles and information on working at AISquared.
- [Contact Us](https://aisquared.ai/contact/): Ways to get in touch with the AISquared team.
- [Request a Demo](https://aisquared.ai/request-demo): Book a guided walkthrough of the platform.


## Platform


- [UNIFI](https://aisquared.ai/unifi/): Core platform to connect data and AI sources, orchestrate agentic workflows in natural language, embed AI into existing systems, and govern usage with zero-trust security.
- [Enterprise](https://aisquared.ai/enterprise/): UNIFI for enterprises scaling AI beyond pilots, with governance, audit logs, and VPC or on-prem deployment.
- [Federal](https://aisquared.ai/federal/): UNIFI for mission-critical AI in secure and regulated government environments.
- [Sparx Agent](https://aisquared.ai/sparx/): AI agents for growing businesses to get operational AI quickly without infrastructure overhaul.
- [Integrations](https://aisquared.ai/integrations/): Library of 100+ connectors across data sources, LLMs, business apps (Salesforce, Dynamics 365, ServiceNow, Slack), and workflow tools.


## Solutions by Team


- [IT & Data](https://aisquared.ai/it-data-teams/): Embed AI into enterprise systems, reduce integration backlog, govern usage, and measure impact.
- [Tech & Innovations](https://aisquared.ai/tech-innovations-teams/): Build, deploy, and iterate quickly while proving ROI inside real workflows.
- [Security & Compliance](https://aisquared.ai/security-compliance-teams/): Enforce access policies, maintain audit logs, and deploy in VPC or on-prem environments.
- [Operations](https://aisquared.ai/operations-teams/): Automate processes and deliver insights inside CRM and finance tools to reduce manual reporting.
